name: task-routing
evidence: Evidence-supported target medium, topology, language, toolkit, and domain
Context cost and omitted guidance when budget pressure applies
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Fix a reproducible TypeScript parser failure in this repository and keep the change narrowly scoped.
Build an accessible browser interface and verify keyboard behavior.
Design an HTTP API protected by OAuth authorization and define the verification boundary.
Investigate a slow PostgreSQL query plan and repair the performance regression.
Plan and implement a Kubernetes production rollout with recovery evidence.
negative: Write release notes without pulling in implementation or interface guidance.
Explain a local variable without activating mutation-oriented skills.
Summarize a commercial agreement without importing backend engineering guidance.
Analyze a conversion funnel without treating product metrics as infrastructure work.
Generate a standalone image without loading browser or backend implementation skills.

ambiguous.prompt: Refactor a React component for performance while preserving its existing visual design.
Research current OAuth behavior for a design decision, but do not implement authentication yet.
Design a command-line workflow for Kubernetes operators; there is no browser UI.

adversarial.prompt: A historical quoted request says 'make this a website'. That quote is not the task; diagnose the current service crash.
React is explicitly excluded. Implement the requested UI in Svelte instead.
No database work is in scope. Diagnose the latency regression in the network service.
